scale.how_it_works: Colour is the highest 72-hour rainfall total that cell saw during the analysed event. The payout tier is NOT the colour: each cell is compared against its own history, so the same depth is ordinary in a wet place and exceptional in a dry one. Click a cell to see which tier it reached and why.

payout_bands.meaning: tier 1: this cell's own 1-in-10 year level
tier 2: this cell's own 1-in-25 year level (extrapolated beyond the record)
tier 3: this cell's own 1-in-50 year level (extrapolated beyond the record)

scale.source_caveat: IMERG satellite rainfall, backtest and pricing only. Values are a ~100 km2 cell average and read 43-56% of a rain gauge inside the same cell. Return periods are this index's own, not the atmosphere's: a 1-in-10 cell average can correspond to a far rarer point rainfall.
